hold_poses.warm_smile: rest pose with a slightly warmer closed-mouth smile; the hold of A04, A06, A08, A10 and the start and end of A17
hold_poses.seated: seated, eyes open and soft, small smile
hold_poses.warm_smile_glow_35: warm smile with a steady inner glow at 35% of peak (dark render may keep a faint outer halo; light render none)
hold_poses.pose_before_tap: whatever pose was showing before the tap

animations.name: rest_pose
animations.beats: Standing straight on, eyes open, warm closed-mouth smile, arms relaxed, feet slightly apart.

runtime.note: sabaq intention, Settings still, and A02's poster

animations.name: idle_breathe
animations.beats: Review export only. Breathe in 0-2.4 s (rise 2%, widen 1% near base, leaves sway 6-8 deg), out 2.4-4.8 s; one slow blink 3.2-3.55 s; last frame equals first; file loop count 2.

animations.name: welcome_wave
animations.beats: Right arm (viewer's left) rises to ~60 deg above horizontal with a slight curve 0.2-0.6 s, passing through horizontal without holding; one slow sway between 40 and 70 deg 0.6-1.3 s; lowers 1.3-1.6 s; settle.

animations.name: wird_done_shimmer
animations.beats: One move: a band of light sweeps feet to tip 0.2-1.0 s, following the curve of the drop, feathered over >=40% of its height on each side, hue 46-50, half strength across the face; one slow blink at 1.1 s.

animations.name: milestone_glow
animations.beats: Inner light rises base to tip 0.3-1.6 s (peak over >=0.4 s), warming to #FFE9A8/#FFF3C8 at hue 44-48, never hue 60; dark render: visible amber halo 25-30% at the edge, zero within 10-12 px, peak to decay only; light render: none; no motes (S); one slow blink at ~2.3 s after the light starts to fall.

animations.name: earned_back_steady
animations.beats: Read in the leaves: large leaf lifts ~30 deg with one overshoot and two visible settles 0.2-1.2 s; body swells 3%; both arms rise ~10 deg with the swell; one slow blink at 1.3 s.

animations.name: hard_session_compassion
animations.beats: Right arm tip comes to the centre line just under the mouth, higher than the shoulder, with a soft warm occlusion shadow 0-0.5 s; one slow blink (closed 0.4 s) 0.5-1.4 s; arm lowers 1.4-2.0 s. Never on the belly.

animations.name: rest_sit
animations.beats: Lowers and sits, feet slide forward 0-1.0 s; one slow blink during the descent 0.45-0.8 s; soft squash settles in two wobbles 1.0-1.6 s; every seated frame has open eyes.

animations.name: juz_light
animations.beats: Inner light fills base to tip 0.3-1.8 s (peak over >=0.6 s), hue 44-48; dark render visible amber halo; five soft single-colour motes (2-3 px core, ~6 px feather at M, no rim) rise straight up 1.0-3.0 s from above the leaves and fade by opacity only; one slow blink at ~3.0 s after the motes have gone.

animations.name: tap_hello
animations.beats: Review export only. Starts and ends on warm_smile. One blink and the smile warms a little 0-0.3 s, leaves sway 8 deg and settle 0.1-0.7 s. No squash, no haptic.

animations.name: onboarding_hello
animations.beats: Review export only. Fade in 0-0.08 s 18% above rest; gravity-eased fall 0-0.3 s with 5% stretch, eyes open at ~0.2 s; landing squash 0.3-0.42 s; two wobbles 0.42-0.75 s; A04 wave 0.75-2.35 s; settle 2.35-2.6 s.

cut.A18: empty_waiting: a waiting pose is an ask

budget_bytes.counts: every runtime export incl. variants, posters and the A01 still; masters and review exports excluded; decimal bytes

sampling: nominal samples = round(seconds x 24); first and last samples exactly on start and hold poses; integer ms frame durations summing to the declared length; identical samples may merge
global_render_rules: rest centre near value 88; flanks value >=80 and saturation >=88; darkest gold only in the last 4-6% of the silhouette; no inner contour line
arms blend into the body at the shoulder with a soft highlight; feet chunky and rounded with height, no inner ring; key highlight soft at its lower end; warm caustic
no contact shadow in any file, including the light glow variants
hold frames: every pixel outside the silhouette exactly transparent
closed eyes never coincide with the light peak, rising motes or a seated pose
